Offline mode never sends anything off the phone and works without internet once the language packs are downloaded. Text recognition supports Latin, Chinese, Devanagari, Japanese and Korean scripts.
Encrypted with the Android Keystore. Stays on this phone; sent only to the service it belongs to.
Keys saved, encrypted on this phone
Could not encrypt the keys, so they were not saved
The DeepL and Gemini keys are deleted from this phone. Online engines that need them fall back to offline.
Translates on the phone. Fast and private, but less accurate.
Sends the screen\'s text to Google Translate. No key needed; this unofficial endpoint can stop working or be rate-limited.
Sends the screen\'s text to DeepL. Get a free key (500,000 characters a month) at deepl.com/pro-api.
Sends the screen\'s text to Google Gemini, which translates with context and fixes OCR mistakes. Get a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey.
Online translation failed (%1$s). Used offline instead.
